Authentic, delicious and affordable Indian restaurant
May 2024 • Couples
Surprise restaurant in the old town. The right level of spiciness and rich flavors, this is the best Indian restaurant I have ever eaten at. My wife and I have eaten at a few Indian restaurants in the past, but none of them left a lasting impression on us like this one. The price is also very reasonable. What a pity it runs in Hanoi but not Shenzhen. Highly recommend to travellers who intend to visit Hanoi Old Quarter.

Dinner in Hanoi
May 2024 • Friends
If authentic Indian (Punjabi) food is what you are craving for, this is the place to go! 
Eat List makes you feel at home with their delicious Punjabi menu. 
We tried their Bhindi Masala, Kadhi Pakoda and Masala Chaas, not to forget the home like chapatis and jeera rice. 
Jass is an amazing host and welcomes all guests so warmly with all his heart. 
This place is a must visit while in Hanoi Old Quarters.
